For rho=1/2 independent binary digits give full support, uniformity iff p=1/2 and singular entropy dimension otherwise. Boundaries eps=min, rho=1/2, z=0/1, m=3 and p rational all inspected. Independently wrote and ran 26,928 exact directed gate/moment checks and 704 two-edge escaping witness checks; finite checks do not establish the infinite assertions.
